We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

Checkout.com is looking for an enthusiastic Engineer I to join Finance Technology with a focus on Workday Adaptive Planning. Adaptive Planning supports finance, workforce, sales, and operational planning, giving teams a shared platform for budgeting, forecasting, modelling, reporting, and decision-making.

This is an early-career engineering role for someone who wants to build depth in finance systems, application configuration, data integration, and operational support. You will work with Finance, Finance Technology, Data, and wider Corporate Technology teams to keep planning processes reliable, well-controlled, and easy to operate.

You will have support from more senior engineers for complex design decisions, but you will be expected to work independently for longer periods on well-defined configuration, integration, support, and continuous-improvement tasks. This reflects Checkout’s Engineer 1 expectations: delivering small-to-medium-sized work, supporting common operational flows, communicating clearly, and taking ownership of the quality of what you deliver.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Configure, maintain, and enhance Adaptive Planning models, dimensions, versions, levels, accounts, sheets, reports, dashboards, and planning workflows under appropriate guidance.

  • Support the delivery of budgeting, forecasting, headcount planning, scenario modelling, and management reporting capabilities for Finance and business stakeholders.

  • Build and support data loads and integrations between Adaptive Planning, Workday Financials, Workday HCM, and other approved internal or third-party systems.

  • Maintain data mappings, transformation rules, validation checks, and reconciliation processes so that planning data is complete, accurate, and traceable.

  • Monitor scheduled loads and integration tasks, investigate failures, and resolve common data or configuration issues within agreed service levels.

  • Triage incidents and service requests, identifying root causes and escalating complex or high-risk issues with clear evidence and recommended next steps.

  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into maintainable system configuration, reporting, or integration changes.

  • Contribute to the assessment and delivery of future analytics data flows, including the potential use of Adaptive Planning data in BigQuery and management analytics.

  • Participate in testing, regression testing, release preparation, and controlled deployment of Adaptive Planning changes.

  • Follow change-control, access-management, data-quality, and audit requirements relevant to financial systems and planning data.

  • Create clear documentation, support guides, data dictionaries, integration runbooks, and knowledge-base articles so that operational knowledge is shared rather than held by one person.

  • Identify recurring manual work or failure patterns and propose practical automation and process improvements.

What we’re looking for

Essential experience and skills

  • Experience in a finance systems, enterprise applications, data, reporting, or integration environment.

  • Practical experience with Workday Adaptive Planning, or strong experience with a comparable planning, performance-management, ERP, or finance application and a clear ability to learn Adaptive quickly.

  • Understanding of core finance planning concepts such as budgets, forecasts, actuals, variance analysis, allocations, dimensions, hierarchies, and scenarios.

  • Experience configuring or supporting structured data models, application workflows, reports, dashboards, or business rules.

  • Ability to work with data imports, exports, mappings, transformations, validations, and reconciliations.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, with the ability to break down an issue, gather evidence, identify likely causes, and communicate findings clearly.

  • Good attention to detail and an understanding of why accuracy, access control, auditability, and repeatability matter in finance systems.

  • Ability to manage small-to-medium-sized tasks independently while knowing when to ask for help or escalate.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with Finance and Technology stakeholders.

Desirable experience

  • Workday Adaptive Planning certification or implementation experience.

  • Experience with Adaptive Planning Integration, Planning Data Loader, APIs, or equivalent enterprise planning integration tooling.

  • Experience integrating planning systems with Workday Financials, Workday HCM, an ERP, a data warehouse, or a reporting platform.

  • Familiarity with SOX controls, financial audit requirements, data privacy, and segregation of duties.

  • Experience supporting month-end, budget, forecast, or management-reporting cycles.

  • Exposure to Agile delivery, ticket-driven change management, incident management, or service-management practices.

What success looks like

After the first 6–12 months, you will be able to:

  • Support common Adaptive Planning configuration, data-load, and reporting requests with limited supervision.

  • Diagnose and resolve routine integration or data-quality issues using a structured troubleshooting approach.

  • Deliver small-to-medium-sized enhancements from requirement clarification through testing, documentation, and controlled release.

  • Explain key planning data flows, mappings, dependencies, and operational controls to Finance and Technology colleagues.

  • Improve the reliability or efficiency of at least one recurring planning or finance-technology process.

  • Maintain accurate, useful documentation and contribute positively to team ceremonies, reviews, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

Working style and behaviours

We are looking for someone who:

  • Takes ownership of tasks and follows through on commitments.

  • Acts with urgency and accountability when issues affect Finance or business reporting.

  • Is curious about how finance processes, data, and technology fit together.

  • Communicates clearly, especially when explaining risk, blockers, trade-offs, or support impact.

  • Welcomes feedback and actively develops their technical and domain knowledge.

  • Collaborates generously and shares knowledge so the team does not depend on a single subject-matter expert.

  • Looks for durable automation and simpler operating processes rather than repeatedly working around the same manual problem.

Why join Finance Technology?

You will work on systems that sit at the centre of how Checkout.com plans, forecasts, reports, and makes financial decisions. The role offers the opportunity to develop a broad foundation across enterprise applications, finance processes, integrations, data quality, controls, and automation while working closely with experienced Finance and Technology professionals.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Checkout is looking for an experienced financial crime compliance lead to establish, grow, and maintain a global second-line team. This role will oversee the compliance frameworks supporting our rapidly evolving portfolio of mass market products.

  • Experience improving efficiency through automation of privacy processes. 

  • Legal, operational-risk or dedicated data-protection qualifications. 

LI-AP1

At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.

We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.

You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.

*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice

 

Diversity Statement

Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 

 

Our approach to AI in interviews

At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 

Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 

Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 

Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Life at THG Nutrition</strong></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p data-start="353" data-end="578">THG Nutrition is home to some of the world’s most trusted and best-loved wellbeing and nutrition brands, including Myprotein, the world’s largest online sports nutrition brand, alongside Myvegan, Myvitamins and MP Activewear.</p> <p data-start="580" data-end="776">Our brands and people exist to break boundaries — to power and empower those who want more. We move fast, challenge convention, and back ourselves to win. These values shape how we work every day.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Role: Category Manager | Bars &amp; Snacks</strong></p> <p><strong>Reporting to: Category Director</strong></p> <p><strong>Brand: Myprotein</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: THG HQ, Manchester (WA15 0AF) - Fully Office Based</strong></p> <p><strong>THG Nutrition:</strong></p> <p>THG Nutrition is home to some of the best loved and most trusted names in wellbeing and nutrition, including Myprotein, the world's largest online sports nutrition brand, and its family of brands, &nbsp;Myvitamins and MP Activewear. Our brands and people exist to break boundaries; to power and empower those who want more.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>As the Category Manager, you will be responsible for driving the online commercial success of Bars &amp; Snacks. You will optimise the ecommerce strategy for these categories, ensuring commercial growth and customer engagement across global markets in line with out omni-channel business.</p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><em><strong>Category Performance &amp; Strategy</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Develop and implement bars &amp; snacks strategies to maximise online sales, market share, and profitability.</li> <li>Analyse internal insights (sales data, pricing trends, site metrics) to make data-driven decisions that optimise category performance.</li> <li>Identify category growth opportunities, leveraging global and regional insights to tailor strategies for each market.</li> <li>Conduct frequent site audits to ensure optimal customer experience (CX) and category visibility.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Market &amp; Competitor Analysis</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Monitor external market trends, including competitor pricing, innovation, and emerging category trends.</li> <li>Leverage insights to develop category plans and influence product launches, pricing, and promotional strategies.</li> <li>Collaborate with the Brand &amp; Marketing teams to align product positioning with industry trends and customer demand.</li> <li>Collaborate with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok &amp; Amazon teams to understand insights &amp; omnichannel sales to drive online decisions.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Pricing &amp; Promotion Optimisation</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Own the pricing strategy for assigned categories, ensuring profitability while remaining competitive in each market.</li> <li>Work closely with country managers to optimise pricing across Myprotein sites, balancing growth and margin targets.</li> <li>Work closely with the internal Retail, Wholesale, Tiktok &amp; Amazon teams to balance the calendar plans to drive growth across channels</li> <li>Develop and implement promotional plans, working with digital marketing teams to drive customer acquisition and retention.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Partner with supply chain &amp; production teams to ensure optimal stock availability across all international warehouses.</li> <li>Collaborate with procurement, finance &amp; logistics to improve cost efficiencies and bottom-line profitability.</li> <li>Support senior stakeholders in optimising locale &amp; sales channels mix, reducing cost prices, and managing discount strategies.</li> <li>Work closely with customer service teams to address category-specific customer concerns, ensuring a customer-centric approach to category management.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Performance Tracking &amp; Reporting</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Establish and maintain reporting processes to track category performance at a territory level.</li> <li>Present insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.</li> <li>Continuously monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and adjust strategies accordingly to drive category success.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Proven experience in Ecommerce, Category Management, or Digital Trading, ideally within retail, FMCG, or nutrition/bars &amp; snacks sectors.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into actionable strategies.</li> <li>Commercial mindset with experience in pricing, promotion, and margin optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to build strong cross-functional relationships and influence stakeholders across marketing, finance, supply chain, and country teams.</li> <li>Detail-oriented with a strong understanding of customer experience (CX) and ecommerce best practices.</li> <li>Proficiency in analytics tools (e.g., BI platforms i.e. Tableau) and ecommerce platforms.</li> <li>Strong organisational and communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities.</li> <li>Proficiency in excel, SQL &amp; Ai Tools would be desirable as well, but not essential</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><span title: Account Liaison Officer | THG Manufacturing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About THG</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:160,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are THG, a global ecommerce group on a mission to be the global online leader in beauty and sports nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Our portfolio of</span><span data-contrast="auto"> leading retailers and brands such as LOOKFANTASTIC, Myprotein, ESPA, Perricone MD, and Cult Beauty form our two core businesses: THG Beauty and THG Nutrition.</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">From Manchester to New York, we’re powered by a team of over 2500 people who work together, lead by example, and think BIG.&nbsp;</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">With us, you’ll go further, faster. What are you waiting for?</span><span data-ccp-props="{&quot;134233117&quot;:false,&quot;134233118&quot;:false,&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335551550&quot;:1,&quot;335551620&quot;:1,&quot;335559685&quot;:0,&quot;335559737&quot;:0,&quot;335559738&quot;:240,&quot;335559739&quot;:240,&quot;335559740&quot;:279}">&nbsp;</span></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Location: Omega, WA5 3TP (3 days) / Icon 1, WA15 0AF (1 day) / WFH (1 day)</span></strong></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="none">About THG Manufacturing</span></strong></p> <p><strong>THG Manufacturing</strong> is the dedicated, high-growth contract manufacturing and co-manufacturing division of THG PLC. Operating from state-of-the-art, BRCGS-accredited manufacturing facilities globally, we partner with prestigious household names and global powerhouse brands who trust us to formulate, produce, and scale their product ranges.</p> <p>Our specialised manufacturing capabilities include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Powder Blending</strong> (sports nutrition, lifestyle powders, functional health formulations)</li> <li><strong>Tablets &amp; Capsules</strong> (vitamins, minerals, and dietary supplements)</li> <li><strong>Protein Bar Manufacturing</strong> (extruded, layered, and premium enrobed formats)</li> <li><strong>Fruit Preparations &amp; Concentrates</strong> (aseptic processing and clean-label infusions)</li> </ul> <p><strong>An Unrivaled Growth Trajectory</strong></p> <p>This is an exceptional time to join our division. THG Manufacturing achieved <strong>300% growth this year</strong>, is forecast to deliver another <strong>100% growth next year</strong>, and is firmly on track to expand into a <strong>£100 million division within 5 years purely in co-manufacturing</strong>. Global powerhouse brands trust us under multi-year co-manufacturing agreements, validating our industry credibility, technical excellence, and manufacturing reliability.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly organised, proactive, and customer-focused <strong>Account Liaison Officer </strong>to join our fast-paced co-manufacturing division, reporting directly into the <strong>Commercial Director</strong>.</p> <p>In this role, you will serve as the primary operational conduit between our valued external co-manufacturing partners and internal site functions, including Production, Planning, Logistics, and Quality. You will drive day-to-day operational execution, clear customer communication, and end-to-end order tracking—ensuring customer forecasts, purchase orders, production timelines, and stock reconciliations run smoothly from inception through to dispatch.</p> <p><strong>As an Account Liaison Officer you will:</strong></p> <p><strong>Customer Liaison &amp; Communication</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Point of Contact:</strong> Act as the first port of call for day-to-day customer enquiries regarding production updates, lead times, batch progress, and dispatch schedules.</li> <li><strong>Customer Updates &amp; Reviews:</strong> Prepare and participate in regular operational update calls with customers, providing transparent visibility on open order status and delivery milestones.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Coordination:</strong> Collaborate closely with internal factory teams (Planning, Production, Materials Management, Quality, and Dispatch) to ensure client requirements are understood and executed smoothly.</li> <li><strong>Escalation Support:</strong> Promptly raise and track operational bottlenecks or supply chain escalations with internal stakeholders and the Commercial Director, keeping customers proactively informed of resolutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Demand, Supply &amp; Production Coordination</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Demand Planning Interface:</strong> Collate customer demand forecasts and align them with internal planners to assess production line capacity and material requirements.</li> <li><strong>Supply Planning &amp; OTIF Monitoring:</strong> Track component and raw material deliveries to support target On-Time, In-Full (OTIF) manufacturing schedules.</li> <li><strong>Production &amp; Kitting Schedules:</strong> Liaise with site operational teams across our powder blending, bar, tableting, and fruit preparation plants to monitor kitting activities and scheduled production runs.</li> <li><strong>Supply Health Tracking:</strong> Support regular supply health and risk reporting, flagging potential raw material or component shortages before they impact production plans.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Order Processing &amp; Systems Administration</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Order Processing:</strong> Accurately translate customer purchase orders into production and planning schedules across THG’s planning systems.</li> <li><strong>THG Ingenuity Systems:</strong> Raise, monitor, and coordinate production orders within THG’s proprietary Ingenuity platform.</li> <li><strong>B2B Portal &amp; Price List Set-Up:</strong> Assist with setting up customer price lists on the THGB2B portal and ensure quarterly pricing uploads and system adjustments are maintained accurately in line with agreed terms.</li> <li><strong>New Product Range Administration:</strong> Assist in setting up initial reporting suites, tracking master SKU data, and ensuring data alignment for new product range introductions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Inventory Reconciliation &amp; Operational Control</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Free-Issued Stock Reconciliation:</strong> Perform regular reconciliations of customer-supplied (free-issued) raw materials, packaging, and ingredients, tracking usage, investigating discrepancies, and reporting remaining balances.</li> <li><strong>Finance &amp; Timings Alignment:</strong> Provide timely order movement and production timing updates to the Commercial Director and Finance teams to support revenue tracking and month-end financial reviews.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What skills and experience do I need for this role?</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential Requirements</strong></p> <ul> <li>Previous experience in a customer service, client liaison, supply chain coordination, account coordination, or production administration role (ideally within FMCG, food &amp; beverage, packaging, or manufacturing).</li> <li>Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to maintain clear, professional, and positive customer relationships.</li> <li>High accuracy in order processing, stock reconciliation, and maintaining system data.</li> <li>Basic understanding of production workflows, material lead times, and supply chain processes.</li> <li>Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, lookups, reporting spreadsheets) and comfort working with ERP, MRP, or proprietary ordering portals.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable Attributes</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience working within contract manufacturing (co-man) or third-party client operations.</li> <li>Familiarity with food, nutrition, or pharmaceutical manufacturing standards (e.g., BRCGS, GMP).</li> </ul> <p><strong>Working Pattern &amp; Office Locations</strong></p> <p>Collaboration and close proximity to our manufacturing plants are essential to our operational velocity. This role follows a <strong>hybrid model (4 days on-site / 1 day remote)</strong>:</p> <ul> <li><strong>3 Days per week:</strong> THG Omega Campus, Warrington (flagship operational &amp; manufacturing campus)</li> <li><strong>1 Day per week:</strong> Icon 1, Manchester Airport (THG Global Headquarters)</li> <li><strong>1 Day per week:</strong> Flexible Work from Home (WFH)</li> </ul> <p><strong>What's in it for me?</strong></p> <p><strong>Career Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access bespoke development programmes that have been designed and developed by our in-house L&amp;D team.</li> <li>Continued development through our upskilling programme that is delivered in partnership with an industry-leading training provider.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Enhanced Leave</strong></p> <ul> <li>25 days annual leave plus bank holidays.</li> <li>Don’t want to work on your birthday? We don’t either! Enjoy your day off on us!</li> <li>Enhanced maternity and paternity pay, depending on length of service.</li> <li>Up to 10 days compassionate leave.</li> <li>Buy back up to 3 days each year.</li> <li>Unlock 2 days volunteer leave after 12-months.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wellbeing Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Access face-to-face and virtual appointments with our in-house GP.</li> <li>Access our 247 Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) which is provided by Bupa.</li> <li>State-of-the-art on-site gym.</li> <li>Access to our on-site physio.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Other Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li>Save up to 12% on the cost of personal tech through our salary sacrifice scheme.</li> <li>Subsidised bus pass from Manchester City Centre to our ICON office.</li> <li>Up to 50% staff discount on THG brands.</li> <li>On-site staff shop.</li> <li>Know someone who would be perfect for THG? Refer them and get up to £1000 when they pass their probation.</li> <li>Anniversary gifts when you hit 5 and 10 years of service.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>THG is proud to be a Disability Confident Committed employer. We endeavour to respond to every application we receive within 14 days. title: Senior Event Production Manager
description: <p><strong>Senior Event Production Manager (Planning)</strong></p> <p>Please note: candidates must currently reside in the UK and be able to work in the UK without sponsorship.</p> <p>Convene Hospitality Group (CHG) operates a global portfolio of lifestyle brands focused on creating places and experiences that bring people together. The company designs, develops, and operates hospitality-driven destinations to host gatherings of all kinds, ranging from small corporate meetings to immersive brand activations and beyond. We love bringing people together in person, and that passion for great experiences extends to our employees as well. If you're interested in creating inspiring moments of connection, consider joining our team.</p> <p>The <strong>Senior Event Production Manager (Planning)</strong> is responsible for overseeing the planning and execution of events, ensuring seamless coordination between clients and internal teams. Acting as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the planning process, this role ensures that all aspects of an event – from logistics and technical production to catering and on-site operations – are delivered to the highest standard. The role requires strong leadership, project management, and communication skills to ensure client expectations are met while maintaining operational efficiency.</p> <p><strong>Key responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>Team Leadership &amp; Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead and manage the Events Team, ensuring effective staff scheduling and resource allocation.</li> <li>Conduct biannual appraisals and regular one-to-one meetings with direct reports, providing training and professional development plans.</li> <li>Ensure all team members adhere to company policies and procedures, including compliance with statutory Health &amp; Safety training requirements.</li> <li>Maintain high standards of performance and service delivery within the team.</li> <li>Ensure strong cross-functional collaboration with other departments, including Sales and Operations.</li> <li>Oversee team performance management, including probation reviews, performance improvement plans, and disciplinary procedures where required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Events Planning &amp; Coordination</strong>:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Oversee the planning and execution of events across physical, hybrid, and virtual formats.</li> <li>Act as the main client liaison during the planning phase, ensuring clear communication and alignment with their requirements.</li> <li>Develop and maintain detailed event documentation, including Programme Execution Orders (PEOs), room layouts, event timelines, and client deliverables.</li> <li>Conduct client kick-off meetings, providing guidance on deadlines, requirements, and production schedules.</li> <li>Collaborate with internal teams, including AV production, catering, and operations, to finalise event logistics.</li> <li>Ensure all pre-event planning milestones are met, providing regular updates to stakeholders.</li> <li>Manage client expectations regarding event capabilities and work with Product and Design teams on potential platform improvements.</li> <li>Facilitate pre-event and post-event debriefs with internal teams and clients, ensuring continuous improvement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work closely with the Sales Team to support pre-sales activities, advising on event feasibility, logistics, and timelines.</li> <li>Assist in the creation of event proposals, room diagrams, and other pre-sales materials.</li> <li>Oversee event budget management, ensuring accurate cost calculations, approvals, and final invoicing.</li> <li>Supervise on-site event operations, ensuring smooth execution and addressing any challenges in real time.</li> <li>Ensure the team adheres to company service standards and hospitality protocols at all times.</li> <li>Lead weekly event meetings and Programme Execution Order (PEO) discussions, ensuring alignment across all stakeholders.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Skills &amp; Experience</strong></p> <p><strong>Essential:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive experience in event planning and production, with a strong background in physical, hybrid, and virtual event formats.</li> <li>Proven leadership and team management experience.</li> <li>Strong organisational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple events simultaneously.</li> <li>Excellent client relationship management and communication skills.</li> <li>Knowledge of AV production, catering logistics, and event operations.</li> <li>Proficiency in event management software and project management tools.</li> <li>2 years experience in large-scale corporate event planning.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Desirable:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with virtual event platforms and livestream production.</li> <li>Budget management experience within an events setting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We’re Here For You:</strong></p> <p>At Convene Hospitality Group, we want you to feel supported in every part of your life. Here’s what you can expect:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Health &amp; Wellness:</strong>&nbsp;Private medical insurance, subsidised fitness and eye care, plus well-being and personal support programs. Because your well-being matters, inside and outside of work.</li> <li><strong>Time Off &amp; Balance:</strong>&nbsp;25 days annual leave, bank holidays, and company sick pay.</li> <li><strong>Financial Benefits:</strong>&nbsp;Bonus scheme, interest-free loans for rail travel or further education, and a Cycle to Work program. We invest in you so you can grow personally and professionally.</li> <li><strong>Growth &amp; Recognition:</strong>&nbsp;Career development opportunities and programs to celebrate your achievements.</li> <li><strong>Community &amp; Impact:</strong>&nbsp;Volunteer, donate, and make a real impact through your work.</li> </ul> <p>At Convene Hospitality Group, we believe great teams are built by bringing together people with different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences. Our values of GRIT (Genuine, Relentless, Integrity, and Teamwork) shape how we show up for each other every day. We want everyone here to feel welcome, supported, and free to be themselves. If you’re excited to grow, learn, and make an impact, we’d love to have you on the team.</p> <p>Convene Hospitality Group is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Remote UK
description: Who We Are At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing. Why Join Us We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you. About the Role We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads. This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.   What You'll Be Doing BAU & Platform Stability Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes. Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments. Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes. raw.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - Remote UK
raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Notice to Recruiters and Staffing Agencies: To protect the interests of all parties, Partnerize will not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than directly from a candidate or an approved vendor that has a written and signed agreement in place with Partnerize. Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.description:
Who We Are

At Partnerize, we're on a mission to transform the way businesses grow. We've built the leading partnership automation platform that empowers brands to discover, engage, and convert their audiences at scale. From affiliate marketing to influencer collaborations, we help our clients build and manage profitable partnerships that drive real results. We're a team of passionate problem-solvers who are dedicated to helping our clients win in the ever-evolving world of digital marketing.

Why Join Us

We're looking for passionate, talented people who want to be part of a winning team. At Partnerize, you'll find a culture of collaboration, innovation, and respect. We're guided by our core values, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone can do their best work. We also offer a competitive salary, generous benefits, and a flexible work environment that allows you to thrive both personally and professionally. If you're ready to grow your career and make a difference, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to join our engineering team and champion the deployment architecture that drives our platform maturity. You'll be embedded within our engineering teams, optimizing day-to-day delivery across our on-premise estate while acting as the key engineering stakeholder to help shape, configure, and roll out our new Kubernetes platform, modernising how we deploy and scale workloads.

This is a hands-on role with real impact. You won't be rubber-stamping tickets; you'll have true autonomy over our CI/CD pipelines, automated guardrails, and migration strategies, shaping how engineering safely and rapidly ships value to production.

 

What You'll Be Doing

BAU & Platform Stability

  • Utilise and contribute to Ansible-based deployment automation to facilitate seamless product feature releases, adhering to established TechOps peer-review processes.
  • Monitor application-level health within the cluster, collaborating with TechOps on incident response and driving post-mortems for engineering-led deployments.
  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. This includes contributing requirements for Kubernetes primitives (such as Gateway API, RBAC, admission controllers, and resource policies) to ensure engineering teams can move fast safely, without compromising core platform stability.
  • Standardise application-level configurations: Work alongside TechOps to establish clear engineering standards within the namespaces for ingress, RBAC, namespacing strategy, and secrets management.
  • Drive phased application migrations: Partner with engineering teams to containerise and migrate existing workloads to Kubernetes, starting with non-critical environments to establish confidence before moving business-critical systems.
  • Build robust deployment pipelines: Establish CI/CD workflows for Kubernetes-based deployments (using Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD, or similar) with automated guardrails to ensure fast, repeatable, and safe code delivery.
  • Implement application observability: Set up application-level metrics, logging, and alerting within the namespaces, ensuring engineering teams have the visibility they need to monitor workload health.
  • Create developer self-service documentation: Document deployment runbooks, manifest templates, and best practices so that engineers can onboard and self-serve safely within the established guardrails.

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Have

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills: we're a people-first culture where teamwork is paramount. On highly technical projects with many moving parts, the ability to collaborate openly, communicate clearly, and bring people with you is just as important as technical ability
  • Strong, demonstrable experience with Ansible: roles, inventories, vault, idempotency, the lot
  • Comfortable with Docker and Docker Compose in production environments
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals
  • Strong scripting ability: Bash and Python
  • Experience with GitOps tooling: ArgoCD or Flux
  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Alertmanager or equivalent)
  • Ability to think creatively within constraints and plan pragmatically around them: our stack is real-world, not greenfield-perfect, and we need someone who can deliver iteratively, working with what exists today while roadmapping towards the ideal state
  • A methodical, security-conscious approach

Nice-to-Have

  • Familiarity with Helm chart authoring and management
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform (even in an on-prem context)
  • Experience with secrets management tooling (HashiCorp Vault, Sealed Secrets, External Secrets Operator)
  • Prior experience in a role where you balanced greenfield work alongside BAU responsibilities

 

The Kind of Person We're After

  • You're comfortable being the person engineering teams come to when something's on fire, and you're also comfortable saying "let me schedule that properly" when it isn't
  • You can hold your own in a conversation with a software engineer, a network engineer, and senior leadership  even if they all want different things
  • You write things down. Runbooks and diagrams: you treat documentation as part of the job, not an afterthought
  • You have opinions about how things should be done, but you're pragmatic; you know when to pick the right tool vs. the perfect tool
  • Autonomously drive outcomes: we're looking for people who demonstrate intent and take initiative, not those who wait to be told what to do next

 

What We Offer

  • True ownership of the delivery lifecycle: The autonomy to shape how we ship code, build pipelines, and automate guardrails, moving entirely away from manual ticket execution.
  • A pivotal role in our cloud-native transformation: The opportunity to act as the key engineering stakeholder shaping our migration to Kubernetes, partnering closely with TechOps to build a modern, scalable platform.
  •  A progressive engineering culture: A collaborative, forward-thinking team that values automation, continuous improvement, and building modern delivery standards.

 

We welcome applications from candidates who don't tick every box. If you've got strong Ansible and Kubernetes experience and the right mindset, we'd love to hear from you.

UK Benefits & Perks

  • 25 days holiday in addition to bank holidays 
  • Enhanced Parental Leave: 6 months full pay for birth parent, 4 weeks non-birth parent at full pay after one year employment
  • 5 extra 'Partnerize Parental Days' each year
  • Private Medical and Dental Insurance 
  • Enhanced pension contributions
  • Cycle to Work scheme 
  • Eye Care Vouchers 
  • Life Assurance
  • Enhanced Wellness Program including access to EAP, Wellness Coaching & Wellness Programs
  • Regular company events and activities

Our Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion

We are committed to attracting, developing, and advancing our outstanding team members, regardless of race, ethnic identity, sexual orientation, religion, age, gender, gender identity, physical abilities, or any other dimension of diversity. We strive to foster an environment where people can be their authentic selves, raise concerns and innovate, all without fear; where they are treated fairly and respectfully, have equal access to opportunities and resources and can contribute fully to the organization's success. Every individual in our business is expected to live this commitment without exception.

Privacy and data protection. The data collected as part of this application will be used for the recruitment process and any subsequent employment. You can find further information in Partnerize privacy policy here: https://partnerize.com/privacy-policy/

Please do not contact or forward resumes to our company employees or locations. Any unsolicited resumes will be considered Partnerize property. Partnerize is not responsible for any charges or fees related to unsolicited resumes.

  • Maintain clear documentation, deployment runbooks, and developer self-service guides to streamline the engineering onboarding and release processes.

Kubernetes 

  • Represent Engineering as a key stakeholder in platform design: Collaborate with TechOps to shape engineering self-service workflows, guardrails, and standards. Must-Have

And we’re a long way from done! LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in! YOUR MISSION We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly. As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business. We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit. We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register. We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice. You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified. Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed. Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice. Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate. DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks. DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required. Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data. Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business. LEGAL & COMPLIANCE @ CARWOW

Our fantastic legal team has been compared to a set of high-performance tyres, enabling Carwow to drive and corner at high speeds whilst keeping Carwow firmly on the road in all conditions. As the business pushes forward with bold ambitions, the legal team’s purpose is clear: to drive Carwow’s growth with integrity and confidence – and that’s where you come in!

YOUR MISSION

We are a platform that sits right in the middle between consumers and OEMs/Dealers in the car-changing journey. Datasits at the heart of everything we do and we want to commercialise it responsibly.

As Senior Privacy Counsel, you will be Carwow’s dedicated in-house privacy lawyer and operational privacy lead, playing a pivotal role in enabling the business to grow and scale at pace with integrity. This is an exciting opportunity to develop your career in a complex, high-growth and data-thirsty marketplace business.

We are looking for a Senior Privacy Counsel who wants to do more than provide legal advice from the sidelines. This is a rare opportunity to join a high-performing legal function as our first dedicated in-house privacy hire, taking ownership of the day-to-day privacy programme while acting as a senior legal and strategic advisor to the business as it sharpens its privacy governance programme and steers towards further growth and an exit.

We are not at “Day Zero”. We currently have an external DPO, established policies, templates, a RoPA and a risk register.

We need a tech-fluent privacy lawyer who is equally comfortable advising and doing: someone who can interpret complex legal requirements, exercise sound legal judgement and provide pragmatic advice, but who will also roll up their sleeves and build, operate and continuously improve the mechanisms that make privacy work in practice.

You will have the mandate to lift the lid on our technology stack, validate our data flows, identify legal and operational privacy risks and work directly with our Product, Engineering, Data, Marketing and commercial teams to keep the business safe and moving fast.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Privacy governance and framework development: Own, develop and maintain Carwow’s enterprise privacy governance framework, encompassing internal policies, ROPAs, privacy notices, risk registers, retention schedules and associated controls. Interpret applicable legal requirements and ensure our documentation and processes reflect the reality of Carwow’s technology stack and processing activities, leading remediation where discrepancies or risks are identified.

  • Legal advice and business partnering: Act as Carwow’s principal in-house legal advisor on privacy and data protection matters. Develop strong business partnering relationships across Marketing, Media, Product, Engineering, Data and other parts of the business, providing pragmatic, risk-based legal advice that enables commercial objectives while appropriately managing privacy risk. Provide advice to senior management and support the General Counsel in updating the Company’s Senior Leadership Team and Executives as needed.

  • Culture & Training: Build a strong internal perception of privacy as a “trust builder”. Design and deliver role-specific training that is engaging, commercially relevant and free of unnecessary legal jargon, helping teams understand both their legal obligations and how to apply them in practice.

  • Breach response: Lead the privacy aspects of data breach and incident response, working cross-functionally to investigate incidents, assess legal and regulatory risk, determine notification obligations and oversee remediation. Liaise with the external DPO, regulators and other relevant stakeholders as appropriate.

  • DPAs, DSAs and data contracting: Draft, review and negotiate DPAs, DSAs and other data protection provisions and agreements arising from commercial arrangements. Provide practical legal advice on controller/processor relationships, data sharing, international transfers and related privacy risks.

  • DSARs and individual rights: Own and continuously improve Carwow’s processes for responding to data subject rights requests, ensuring requests can be handled lawfully, efficiently and with minimal disruption to the business. Provide legal guidance on complex or sensitive requests where required.

  • Retail Media and Ad Tech: Provide legal and operational privacy support on new commercial propositions looking to leverage Carwow’s data for third-party audience targeting, segmentation and advertising. Advise on the appropriate use of personal data, profiling, consent and data-sharing structures and help design commercially workable and legally robust mechanisms for using and sharing data.

  • Product, Data and Technology: Work closely with Data & Insights, IT, Engineering and Product teams throughout the product lifecycle to embed Privacy by Design. Lead or support privacy assessments, identify legal and operational risks in new products and processing activities, and translate complex technical data flows into clear, risk-based advice for the General Counsel, Executives and wider business.

  • Operationalise Compliance: Own and operate core privacy compliance processes, including DPIAs, LIAs and data-sharing assessments. Look continuously for opportunities to integrate these into existing business workflows, with an eye on making compliance proportionate, scalable and automated wherever possible.

  • Regulatory developments: Monitor and interpret relevant developments in privacy, data protection, digital regulation and related areas, assess their impact on Carwow and translate new legal requirements into practical changes to products, policies, controls and business processes.

  • Corporate work: Provide privacy legal support on M&A, funding and other corporate transactions, including conducting privacy due diligence, identifying material risks and supporting remediation and integration activity.

  • AI and emerging technology: Advise on the privacy implications of AI and emerging technologies adopted or developed across the business, while supporting the development of practical governance mechanisms that allow Carwow to innovate responsibly.

  • Multi-jurisdictional: Support Carwow’s businesses across the UK, Germany, Spain and Portugal, advising on relevant local and European privacy requirements and working with external counsel where specialist local advice is required.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A qualified lawyer, admitted to practise in England & Wales or another relevant UK or European jurisdiction, with significant experience advising on privacy and data protection matters.

  • Significant experience working in-house, balancing legal and regulatory requirements with commercial objectives and operating as a trusted advisor to the business.

  • Strong working knowledge of UK and European data protection law, with the ability to interpret legislation, regulatory guidance and emerging issues and translate them into clear, practical and commercially workable advice.

  • Experience not only providing privacy legal advice but also building, operating or materially contributing to a privacy programme, including areas such as DPIAs, RoPAs, privacy notices, data rights, retention, incident response and privacy governance.

  • The ability and willingness to work autonomously as Carwow’s principal in-house privacy specialist, moving comfortably between complex legal analysis and hands-on operational delivery.

  • Passionate about the intersection of AI and privacy, with an interest in how to safeguard the organisation during technology adoption while also leveraging AI to enhance and automate privacy operations.

  • A team player with a growth mindset, high EQ and low ego, excited to be part of a scale-up, high-growth company where every day brings new challenges and opportunities.

  • To be able to work in a fast-paced environment with teams that move and pivot quickly.

  • Fluency in English and strong written and verbal communication skills, together with a proactive, persuasive and adaptable manner.

  • Driven to ensure the Legal & Compliance Team is viewed as a genuine partner to the business, with the initiative and credibility to build relationships across functions and at senior levels.

  • Ability to lead cross-functional projects and influence stakeholders without relying on formal authority.

  • A track record of working effectively with all levels of an organisation, including senior management and executives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience in Mar-Tech or Ad-Tech.

  • Experience in the automotive industry.

  • Experience supporting organisations operating across multiple European jurisdictions.

raw.description:
What is Flagstone?

Flagstone is many things. An online savings platform, reinventing how individuals, businesses, and charities manage, protect, and grow their cash. A diverse group of people, bound by a collaborative spirit, and shared purpose. And lastly, a thriving, profitable business – where smart people do their best work.

Each definition shares a common thread: our unique culture. It’s our pride and joy. And our competitive advantage.


A feel for our culture:

To revolutionise the savings market, we need to be at our best. But high performance takes more than talent – it takes a culture of kindness, respect, and growth.

That’s why we’re building a diverse, inclusive community, where your voice is heard and valued. Where, with close support and room to develop, you can surpass even your own expectations. And be rewarded for it.

We may not change the world, but we can change the world of financial technology. And all it takes is a winning mix of drive, talent, and empathy. Our culture celebrates all three.

But enough about us. Let’s talk about you.


Does this sound like you?

You're a hands-on Engineering Lead, ideally with around 10 years' experience, ready to run a squad with real autonomy. You'll lead the Banks squad on the Bank Portal, the partner-facing application our banking partners use to view and act on their Flagstone relationship. By the time you start, the squad will have delivered the foundational rebuild (migrating banks off the legacy tool to full feature parity), and you'll pick up the next phase: building the commercial capability on top of that foundation and turning the portal into a genuine commercial engine for the partnership.

This is a full-stack squad (.NET backend, React/TypeScript frontend) working in a regulated, data-sensitive environment, so the role carries real weight: partner-facing delivery, strict data isolation between banks, and the judgement calls that come with both.


What you’ll do:
You'll own the squad's technical direction and quarterly roadmap, not just participate in it, driving the commercial features that build on the migrated foundation (self-serve rate changes, new product submissions, liquidity data) while keeping the newly-migrated platform stable and any remaining cohorts or legacy decommissioning on track. You'll make most technical debt and risk calls autonomously, escalating only where tribe-level coordination is genuinely needed.

On people, you'll run day-to-day delivery and performance management, including the harder conversations, handling underperformance and any exits directly rather than deferring them upward. Within the FTC's 12 months, expect the emphasis to sit more on driving commercial delivery at pace than on longer-term development pathways, though coaching engineers and creating stretch opportunities is still part of the job.

You'll also work as a peer across the tribe: contributing to engineering-wide standards, comparing notes with other Team Leads, and representing the squad's constraints and progress in tribe-level planning.

 
What you’ll bring:
We're a Microsoft shop: C#/.NET is our core backend language, on Azure, cloud-first. The Bank Portal specifically runs on .NET (Aspire, Duende BFF, YARP) with a React/TypeScript frontend, so while backend depth is the priority, comfort reviewing across a full-stack architecture matters more here than on a purely backend squad.

We'd like to see a good mix of:

  • Strong commercial C#/.NET experience, with a solid grasp of SOLID, event-driven architecture and DDD

  • RESTful API design and SQL skills

  • Cloud-native Azure development

  • Enough frontend fluency to review React/TypeScript work, even if you're not hands-on day to day

  • TDD in practice (NUnit, MSTest, Playwright/Selenium or similar)

  • Experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code or similar)

  • Comfort working in a regulated or data-sensitive environment, this squad enforces strict per-bank data isolation and audit logging as a core part of the architecture

  • Comfort working in an agile environment, and being the final escalation point for decision making

  • An ability to assess and weigh risk, making sound, defensible decisions rather than deferring by default

And on the people side:

  • A track record of direct, fair performance management, including the difficult conversations

  • Confident stakeholder management, and the ability to translate technical trade-offs for non-technical audiences

  • Genuine enthusiasm for coaching and developing engineers

  • Proactive, collaborative problem-solving

 

How we reward you:

At Flagstone, the benefits extend beyond false gifts like “fruit and snacks”. Instead, we invest in your health, wealth, and professional development. Here’s a selection of our benefits:

  • Hybrid working - Pop into our London office to spend time with team

  • Competitive bonus scheme - designed to reward and recognise high performance

  • Flexible benefits budget - a pot to fund meaningful benefits for you, whether it's hormone or fertility testing, cancer screening, neuro-diversity coaching or something that matters for you.

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <div class="vac_display_field"> <div class="vac_display_field_value"> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">The deadline for applying to this role is Tuesday 13th October 2026, end of day, anywhere on Earth.</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Job summary</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">Within AISI’s Research Unit, the Agentic AI Risk Modelling and Mitigations team studies how advanced AI systems could become difficult to oversee, correct or shut down as they take on longer and more autonomous tasks. The team builds scenario-based risk models that extend published work on AI timelines and systemic risk and uses them to identify practical mitigations such as monitoring infrastructure, deployment guidance and containment protocols. Its analysis has been shared across government and is intended to inform real decisions by the organisations best placed to act.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">We are looking for a Workstream Lead to lead and line-manage this team through its next phase. You will shape the team’s strategy and research agenda, set the scientific direction of its work, and ensure that promising mitigations move from analysis into adoption. This is a senior leadership role for someone who can combine technical judgement, strategic thinking, delivery focus and strong people leadership in a fast-moving and highly consequential area.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">This role sits within AISI’s Research Unit and reports to a Research Unit Deputy Director.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Job description</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">As Workstream Lead for Agentic AI Risk Modelling and Mitigations, you will provide the scientific, strategic and managerial leadership needed to keep the team at the forefront of this area.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">You will be accountable for the team’s research agenda and for the routes to implementation of any mitigations it identifies. This includes setting priorities, choosing analytical approaches, reviewing the quality of outputs, and ensuring the work is relevant to the institutions that can act on it. You will also lead and develop a multidisciplinary team, oversee multiple strands of work at once, and build strong relationships with senior policy and technical stakeholders across government, research organisations and frontier AI companies.</span><span data-ccp-props="{}">&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The team’s aim for March 2027 is for the UK organisations best placed to act to have adopted its existing mitigations, and for newly identified mitigations to move more quickly from research to adoption.
